title.value: AN ACT concerning Environment – Playground Surfacing Materials – Prohibitions
title.provenance: AN ACT concerning Environment – Playground Surfacing Materials – Prohibitions

location.provenance: SECTION 1. BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF MARYLAND

date.provenance: Introduced and read first time: February 7, 2024

pfas_definition.provenance: FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES;

type.provenance: (A) ON OR AFTER OCTOBER 1, 2024, A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN: (1) MORE THAN 90 PARTS PER MILLION OF LEAD; (2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES; AND (3) MORE THAN 20 MILLIGRAMS PER KILOGRAM OF PAH.

date.provenance: SECTION 2. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That this Act shall take effect October 1, 2024.
